name: GetCertificate
label: Get AWS Certificate Manager Certificate
description: Retrieves the certificate body and chain from AWS Certificate Manager using the Certificate ARN.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: AWS Credential (Vault ID)
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: CertificateArn
fields.label: Certificate ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the AWS Certificate Manager certificate to retrieve (e.g., arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/...).

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the certificate is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS Certificate Manager.
